newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel set to push up from 130.26 base.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel set to push up from 130.26 base.

text.p: June notionnel futures have the potential to move higher on Friday, using Thursday's settlement at 130.26 as a base, technical analysts said.
But gains may be limited by fundamental factors, such as politics ahead of the French election, and talk of a possible rate cut, they said.
"Notionnel will use 130.26 as a base, being the old settlement level," said Anil Patel, technical analyst at Nomura International in London. That was the level at Thursday's close.
At 0830 GMT, June notionnel futures were at 130.58, up 32 basis points on the day.
Patel said that although to the downside there should be better support for notionnel than for Bunds, fundamentals might limit any rally.
"There is talk of a rate cut and political factors, both of which could affect notionnel," Patel said.
To the upside, Patel said the contract would aim to move to the 130.90, 131.00 area. That region encompasses the February 25 low at 130.92 and the February 21 and 20 highs at 131.00.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said the notionnel might see some correction higher, but gains would be hard-fought in the short term.
"Resistance at 130.78 held and futures suffered sharp losses, turning daily stochastics negative and causing a sharp retreat in the RSI," they said in a research note.
"This combined with a potential cycle date in the next day, could signal a phase change, suggesting a toppping pattern this week."
They said a break below 130.20 would signal a corrective phase, targeting 129.94 initially and then the 129.66 area.
The low on March 11 was at 129.94, while 129.66 was the low on March 7.
At the short end, June Pibor was at 96.53, up 0.04.
